name: security-settings
title: Security settings cards
description: Account security cards: active sessions with per-row sign-out, and authenticator-app enrollment with a QR code and enable/disable flows. Transport and cache invalidation stay in the host.
postInstall: Render <SecuritySettings labels={...} twoFactorEnabled={...} port={...} /> inside your settings shell. The host supplies translated labels, a sessions/two-factor port and an optional formatDateTime; onSessionsChanged/onTwoFactorChanged let it refresh its cache. Requires the shadcn ui primitives badge, button, card, input and label.
